new.brief: Creates an action that when activated, activates the named action on the widget.
new.md:
Creates an action that when activated, activates
the named action on the widget.

It also passes the given arguments to it.

See [`Widget.insert_action_group()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:insert_action_group) for
how to add actions to widgets.

doc.md:
Activates a named action.

See [`WidgetClass.install_action()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.WidgetClass#method:install_action) and
[`Widget.insert_action_group()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:insert_action_group) for ways
to associate named actions with widgets.

get_action_name.brief: Returns the name of the action that will be activated.
get_action_name.md: Returns the name of the action that will be activated.

action-name.brief: The name of the action to activate.
action-name.md: The name of the action to activate.
